spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (नडति)
To be thick or impervious.
r. 10th cl. (नडयति)
To fall off or from.

m. (-डः)
1 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or karka); also नल.
2 A particular tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelets.
E.
नड to be thick, affix अच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Abounding in reeds, (a field, &c.)
E.
नड a reed, छ affix, and कुक् augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Abounding in reeds.
E.
नड, and प्राय abundance.

m. (-नः)
A small fish, a kind of sprat haunting reedy places.
E.
नड a reed, and मीन a fish.

f. (-तिः)
A quantity of reeds.
E.
नड, and संहति assemblage; also any analogous compound.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Lovely, beautiful, desirable.
E.
नड here said to be mental anxiety, derived from नड to fall off or from, हन to destroy, affix ड.

f. (-ड्या)
A quantity of reeds.
E.
नड a reed, affix यत्.

mfn. (-ड्वान्-ड्वती-ड्वत्)
Reedy, abounding in reeds.
E.
नड, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Reedy, abounding in reeds.
E.
नड, and ड्वलच् aff.

f. (-भूः)
A house or hut of reeds.
E.
नड्व, and भू being, with आङ् prefixed.

f. (-डिः-डी)
1 The stalk or culm of any plant.
2 Any tubular organ of the body, as an artery, a vein, an intestine, &c.
3 The hollow stalk of a lotus, &c.
4 A fistulous sore, a fistula, a sinus.
5 A sort of bent grass.
6 A juggling trick.
7

Deception.
8

An hour of twenty-four minutes.
9 Any pipe or tube.
10 The pulse, either at the hand or feet, &c.
E.
नड to fall off or from, affix अच्, and इ or ङीष्, optionally added.

f. (-का)
An Indian hour, or twenty-four minutes.
E.
नाडि the same, कन् pleonasm.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut: see नारिकेल.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut: see नाडिकेल.

n. (-रं)
A small reed or tube round which the woof is wound; it is then used as a shuttle.
E.
नाडि a tube, and चीर old cloth.

Terrifying.
2

Moving the intestines.
m. (-मः)
A goldsmith.
E.
नाडि a tube, a hollow bambu, &c. and धम who blows, from ध्मा, with खश् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Who or what drinks or sucks through a tube.
E.
नाडि a pipe, धे to drink, affix खश्.

m. (-त्रं)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
E.
नाडि a tube, पत्र a leaf.

n. (-लं)
The celestial equator.
E.
नाडि, and मण्डल a sphere.

n. (-त्रं)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
E.
नाडी a tube, चर to go or grow, affix ड.

m. (-णः)
A bird in general.
E.
नाडी a tube, चरण a foot.

m. (-ङ्घः)
1 A crow.
2 The name of a holy teacher or saint.
3 The name of a fabulous crane.
E.
नाडी a stalk, and जङ्घा a leg or thigh.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A sort of poison: see काकोल.
2 An astrologer.
3 A ravisher, a debaucher.
E.
नाडी an Indian hour, and तरङ्ग a wave; also नाडीतरङ्गक.

m. (-हः)
BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S followers.
E.
नाडी a tube, and देह the body; as thin.

n. (-त्रं)
The planet of a person's nativity.
E.
नाडी, and नक्षत्र an asterism.

m. (-हः)
A name of BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S chief attendants.
E.
नाडी a pipe, and विग्रह the body; also नाडीदेह, &c.

m. (-णः)
An ulcer.
E.
नाडी a sinus, and व्रण a sore.

m. (-हः)
A name of BHṚṄGI: see नाडीदेह.
